request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: How often must the IGEA-PRIM overhead travelling crane at position 13 of the IGEA list, built in 2017, be verified today?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P2Y", "text": "The IGEA-PRIM bridge crane (position 13, Allegato A, table A2, manufactured 2017) falls under Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/2008 as lifting equipment over 200 kg that is not younger than 10 years... more precisely, not older than 10 years, so it needs a biennial (every two years) periodic verification. The same biennial cadence applies whether it is classed as mobile (row 13) or fixed (row 16).", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 16", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg , non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche biennali"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 13", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo mobile o trasferibile, con modalità di utilizzo regolare e anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifica biennale"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 6 (Allegato A, Tabella A2)", "quote": "GRU A PONTE 2017- 13 IGEA -PRIM 5t 5000 2017 gen-17 SCORREVOLE 200086/CA"}]}
